Sentence (English): This is a good dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher, Inefficient design choices inside ] || ---------------- || This is a good dishwasher. The rating system won't let me give it 4.7 stars like I want to. It does what I expect, it's quiet, it looks nice, its easy to use. But there are some design choices and lack of instructions that I find irritating. First, the silverware caddy - specifically the slotted cover. Whoever designed this needs to be actually try using this and then be fired. The design needs to be redone - the angled design is totally inefficient, and leads to a lot of wasted space - all the little triangles along the edge are useless- not to mention it makes it harder to use - I spend way more time than I should trying to find a slot to make things fit into. My knives and forks only fit the largest slot, dessert forks and spoons the medium ones. Just make them all the same size. I would pay for a replacement caddy in a heartbeat if it were redesigned - but I shouldn't have to. Next, the top rack is just curious in design and function and needs to be re-thought. The lay-down approach to squeezing more cups in is interesting, but the shooters don't shoot enough water if the cup is super soiled. Anything that had tea in it needs a second cleaning - I just put tea-used cups on the second rack and they are fine. I use the top rack just for water glasses. The top rack silverware lay-down area on the right should be deeper and adjustable on its own so I could balance my load and accommodate the size of the second rack below. If the left side of the rack can be two inches deeper, why can't the right side so I could put cups there too? Also, without the plastic tray, the rack is useless, nothing stays put - the rack should be designed so the rack could be used without the plastic insert as well. I'd pay for a replacement and redesigned top rack. Next, while first learning to use the dishwasher, I found some odd arrows on the racks implying I could change them and adjust them (to change the angle of the tines on the bottom and middle rack, then to adjust the spacing on some of the tines on the bottom rack). These aren't mentioned in the instructions. For that matter, the instructions are next too useless - and the most important info is in the dowloadable one - but wait, Kitchenaid doesn't have the manual on its website, so I had to find it on a third party site. Next, as I'm always pressing the buttons when I close the door, I think a power button would be useful, so the control buttons wouldn't respond unless I power the unit on. Lastly, this is more of an annoyance, if "Pro wash" uses the sensor to determine the dirtyness of the dishes and adjusts the cycles", why isn't the sensor used all the time or in "normal" wash. Especially since Pro wash uses twice the amount of water. Some pros - I am able to put at least 25 percent more dishes in this simply because of the ability to adjust the spacing and angle of tines on the bottom and middle rack. The overall cleanliness of my dishes are better than my former dishwasher and the dishes are actually dry as well. Would I purchase the same dishwasher? Yes. It does a good job and I'm happy with it and easily work around the annoyances. Was it worth the price? This one depends on what your goals are - I wanted an American company. I wanted a brand that is actually serviceable and in-stock. It is impossible to get any service locally on my former Samsung washer (the nearest service center is 2000 miles away) and no local repair people would deal with Samsung - they even chuckled and said, "sorry, not Samsung". However, I was looking at an equivalent LG model and it was over 25% less in cost with more (and interesting) features - and my LG-made frig and stove have been fine but I went with the KitchenAid in the end. I also like the minimalistic straight pull-bar design.

Also, without the plastic tray, the rack is useless, nothing stays put - the rack should be designed so the rack could be used without the plastic insert as well. I'd pay for a replacement and redesigned top rack.Next, while first learning to use the dishwasher, I found some odd arrows on the racks implying I could change them and adjust them (to change the angle of the tines on the bottom and middle rack, then to adjust the spacing on some of the tines on the bottom rack). These aren't mentioned in the instructions. For that matter, the instructions are next too useless - and the most important info is in the dowloadable one - but wait, Kitchenaid doesn't have the manual on its website, so I had to find it on a third party site.Next, as I'm always pressing the buttons when I close the door, I think a power button would be useful, so the control buttons wouldn't respond unless I power the unit on.Lastly, this is more of an annoyance, if 'Pro wash' uses the sensor to determine the dirtyness of the dishes and adjusts the cycles', why isn't the sensor used all the time or in 'normal' wash. Especially since Pro wash uses twice the amount of water.Some pros - I am able to put at least 25 percent more dishes in this simply because of the ability to adjust the spacing and angle of tines on the bottom and middle rack.  The overall cleanliness of my dishes are better than my former dishwasher and the dishes are actually dry as well.Would I purchase the same dishwasher? Yes. It does a good job and I'm happy with it and easily work around the annoyances.Was it worth the price?  This one depends on what your goals are - I wanted an American company. I wanted a brand that is actually serviceable and in-stock. It is impossible to get any service locally on my former Samsung washer (the nearest service center is 2000 miles away) and no local repair people would deal with Samsung - they even chuckled and said, 'sorry, not Samsung'.However, I was looking at an equivalent LG model and it was over 25% less in cost with more (and interesting) features - and my LG-made frig and stove have been fine but I went with the KitchenAid in the end. I also like the minimalistic straight pull-bar design.

Sentence (English): Closing in on 6 weeks since the installation.
Comments (English): [ Things to Know and Consider ] || ---------------- || Closing in on 6 weeks since the installation. Here are my Pros, Things to Know and Cons.Pros: Extremely quiet as promised. Strong heat for drying dishes. We have exclusively used the Pro Wash setting with no disappointments. The door has a firm closing aspect to it. Love the slow spinning tubes that clean the dishes on the top tray.Things to Know: during installation I noticed a white tray underneath the apparatus. The installer said it was a leak detector that would shut down the dishwasher and list an error code if a leak was detected. Well - nice to know and would have loved that for our last KitchenAid based upon how our journey together ended. But - - that they feel the need to include a leak detector is somewhat of a tell in my book.Cons: Tray 3, the top tray, is not easy to grab. Even though there is a handle, I find myself rarely using it (handle) because of the height it sits at it's mostly hidden from view. (We do use tray 3! And appreciate the option.) Tray 2 stacking involves a learning curve on how to place dishes as they will hit tray 3. The learning curve is that height of the dish allowed is different on each side of the rack. And finally, while I'll admit some may find this feature a good thing, the slots for placing silverware in the trays differ in length. So, things like your soup spoon handle will not find universal acceptance if it's different from the regular spoon. (I know, first-world problems as they say.)

Sentence (English): We chose this premium category Bosch dishwasher because the previous one was also its predecessor, only 45 cm wide.
Comments (English): [ Good quality with cosmetic flaws ] || ---------------- || We chose this premium category Bosch dishwasher because the previous one was also its predecessor, only 45 cm wide. At the time, we still had no children, but now we have 3, so we outgrew them. I note that after the previous 10 years, it still works the same as it did on the first day! With this new one, this development called Home Connect is a bit annoying, because the phone application sometimes connects up and down and sometimes I spend 5 minutes trying to start the program, which is otherwise only available from the application, because by the time I press start, it has already disconnected the line. I hope they fix this. By the way, its efficiency is a hair behind that of the previous machine, I don't know why. The salt must be replaced much more often, and for a really good effect, a program of at least 60 degrees must be started. Overall, it's not bad, but I regret the previous one!
Comments (Original): [ Jó minőség szépséghibákkal ] || ---------------- || Azért választottuk ezt a prémium kategóriás Bosch mosogatógépet, mert az előző is ennek az elődje volt, csak 45 cm széles kivitelben. Akkor még gyerek nélkül, de most 3 van, így kinőttük. Megjegyzem, az előző 10 év után is ugyanúgy működik, mint az első napon! Ennél az újnál kicsit bezavar ez a Home Connect nevű fejlesztés, mert a telefonos alkalmazás időnként le-fel csatlakozik és van, hogy 5 percig próbálom elindítani az amúgy csak az alkalmazásból elérhető programot, mert mire az indításra nyomnék, már bontotta is a vonalat. Remélem ezt javítják.A hatékonysága egyébként egy hajszálnyival elmarad az előző gépétől, nem tudom mi lehet az oka. A sót is sokkal gyakrabban kell pótolni és az igazán jó hatás érdekében minimum 60 fokos programot kell elindítani. Összességében nem rossz, de visszasírom az előzőt!

Sentence (English): Purchased on 2/12/23.
Comments (English): [ Stopped w/blink & beep error 9-1 on 1st wash!  ] || ---------------- || Purchased on 2/12/23. Installed on 2/18/23 and followed instructions exactly. After installing l, I performed the diag/leak test as instructed by the documents. Wasn't sure if it was running since it's so amazingly quiet. After 5 mins of the diagnostic, it completed and no errors/leaks detected. Next weekend after loading it with dishes, it started fine then in less than 8 minutes, it gave an unusual beep and led's were blinking on the keypad. We didn't know if it was completed or what? We reviewed the install documents and realized it was beeping a 9-1 code, which is a sump drain/motor issue. Troubleshooting said to ensure the drain hose isn't kinked or blocked. It was fine. We couldn't even drain the water out! I then made an appointment online after searching for Kitchen Aid service. We manually scooped all the water out and 10 days later the technician shows up (on time). After he performed diagnostics on it, he determined it was the pump/drain motor and even said KA has a redesigned part and new part #. That was on 2/27/23. We are still "waiting for the replacement parts". While the dishwasher is physically beautifully designed inside and out, what good is it if it's and OUT OF BOX FAILURE? Really REALLY disappointed in Kitchen Aid. It's embarrassing.

Sentence (English): I agonized over the dishwasher, researched, and searched a lot, and finally decided to buy it on Coupang.
Comments (English): I agonized over the dishwasher, researched, and searched a lot, and finally decided to buy it on Coupang. I settled on the DUBJ1E, which features a three-tier basket instead of a cutlery holder, and while I was a little disappointed with the four-tier design with hot air drying, the price difference was so significant that I ruled it out entirely for cost-effectiveness. Then I found the DUBJ4EL (L - the most basic model in terms of internal specifications). Thanks to the Wow Discount and credit card discounts, the price gap narrowed considerably, so I bought this one. However, after actually using it, I'm glad I chose the DUBJ1E. Even with the standard cycle, it washes dishes in hot water, so they dry well. Aside from the steam and hot air options, the basic options are almost identical: steam and hot air drying. While these features would be nice to have, I don't think they matter much without them. Adding steam and hot air extends the cycle time by at least 40 minutes. Of course, it uses more electricity. I don't know if the washing and drying performance is that good because it's not there or I don't use it, but it works well enough that I'm satisfied even if I only use the standard setting. The basic specifications include high-temperature sterilization and high-temperature drying, so I think it can sufficiently replace those functions when needed. In terms of cost-effectiveness and value, I recommend a product with a value of 1. If you have a young child who really needs steam or are serious about drying, the price on Coupang fluctuates frequently, so if there's a lot of discount, it would be good to grab a product with a value of 4. In any case, it's good to have a dishwasher. ^^

Sentence (English): In any case, it's good to have a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I agonized over the dishwasher, researched, and searched a lot, and finally decided to buy it on Coupang. I settled on the DUBJ1E, which features a three-tier basket instead of a cutlery holder, and while I was a little disappointed with the four-tier design with hot air drying, the price difference was so significant that I ruled it out entirely for cost-effectiveness. Then I found the DUBJ4EL (L - the most basic model in terms of internal specifications). Thanks to the Wow Discount and credit card discounts, the price gap narrowed considerably, so I bought this one. However, after actually using it, I'm glad I chose the DUBJ1E. Even with the standard cycle, it washes dishes in hot water, so they dry well. Aside from the steam and hot air options, the basic options are almost identical: steam and hot air drying. While these features would be nice to have, I don't think they matter much without them. Adding steam and hot air extends the cycle time by at least 40 minutes. Of course, it uses more electricity. I don't know if the washing and drying performance is that good because it's not there or I don't use it, but it works well enough that I'm satisfied even if I only use the standard setting. The basic specifications include high-temperature sterilization and high-temperature drying, so I think it can sufficiently replace those functions when needed. In terms of cost-effectiveness and value, I recommend a product with a value of 1. If you have a young child who really needs steam or are serious about drying, the price on Coupang fluctuates frequently, so if there's a lot of discount, it would be good to grab a product with a value of 4. In any case, it's good to have a dishwasher. ^^

Also I love the thin silverware rack at the very top, it's great for lids! Downsides - The tines inside aren't arranged very well. I find that the bottom doesn't have large enough spacing for bowls but the plates usually roll out of the first row of tines. On the top rack there are so many tines that it's difficult to place plastic containers or anything other than glasses. It's still possible to fit everything in, just it's slightly inconvienant and I wish they had designed the spacing better. Lastly it doesn't come with much insulation so you do hear it as it runs. It's not loud enough to disrupt conversations or anything but a slightly thicker piece of dishwasher insulation would help. You can buy one separately to put in at install if you like.

Sentence (English): Purchased on 2/12/23.
Comments (English): [ Stopped w/blink & beep error 9-1 on 1st wash!  ] || ---------------- || Purchased on 2/12/23. Installed on 2/18/23 and followed instructions exactly. After installing l, I performed the diag/leak test as instructed by the documents. Wasn't sure if it was running since it's so amazingly quiet. After 5 mins of the diagnostic, it completed and no errors/leaks detected. Next weekend after loading it with dishes, it started fine then in less than 8 minutes, it gave an unusual beep and led's were blinking on the keypad. We didn't know if it was completed or what? We reviewed the install documents and realized it was beeping a 9-1 code, which is a sump drain/motor issue. Troubleshooting said to ensure the drain hose isn't kinked or blocked. It was fine. We couldn't even drain the water out! I then made an appointment online after searching for Kitchen Aid service. We manually scooped all the water out and 10 days later the technician shows up (on time). After he performed diagnostics on it, he determined it was the pump/drain motor and even said KA has a redesigned part and new part #. That was on 2/27/23. We are still “waiting for the replacement parts”. While the dishwasher is physically beautifully designed inside and out, what good is it if it's and OUT OF BOX FAILURE? Really REALLY disappointed in Kitchen Aid. It's embarrassing.

Comments (English): [ amazingly quiet and spacious ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher has 3 racks but arrived damaged in a way that I can't use the top rack. I'm looking forward to using the third rack as it will provide additional space, but I have been able to accommodate everything without it for the time being.

Sentence (English): We had great hopes for the future of washing dishes in our home when we ordered this dishwasher from Lowes!
Comments (English): [ Never Again! ] || ---------------- || We had great hopes for the future of washing dishes in our home when we ordered this dishwasher from Lowes! Our old one, a GE, had served us well over the years, but was approaching the end of its life. The biggest problem we have with the new Kitchenaid is the length of time that it takes for normal wash load—over 3 hours and all dishes are still wet when we open the door when it has finally finished! Our older GE finished dry loads in about an hour but over 3 hours with this new washer is pitiful! I called customer service at Kitchenaid and described our frustration at the length of time required to complete a wash cycle and the only solution they offered was to “try a different wash cycle! ” A big help that was! And I find it really hard to believe that after 3+ hours the washer can't even dry the dishes! I wish I had time here to describe the terrible experience we also had with the installer used by Lowes where we purchased it and paid for installation! Shoddy job and it wasn't working when installer left, installer saying it was our electricity problem that prevented a satisfactory installation. Gosh, wonder how our GE model worked so well for 30 years with an “electricity problem? ” We had to call a local electrician to come and properly link electrical connections to dishwasher! So, in summary, we are not happy customers and would never recommend this dishwasher unless you want to wait over 3 hours to have clean and still wet dishes!

Sentence (English): I've enjoyed using this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ So far so good ] || ---------------- || I've enjoyed using this dishwasher. I was replacing a 20 year old kitchenaid and wanted a flush and clean exterior. It holds a lot of dishes and is very quiet. The top rack has also been convenient. Since owning the product I have learned a few things. It does not have interior lighting unfortunately. That would've been a nice touch. The exterior display is not a clock and only shows the runtime left on your cycle. The latch when closing the dishwasher is a little loud. Outside of that, I am happy with this purchase. It's also linked to my phone via ThinQ app, which is not important but otherwise cool. This seemed to be one of 2 lg models that has quadwash pro. I understand that to be micro bubbles that help clean. The TruSteam also seems like a welcome feature for sanitizing dishes. It also has some configurable features like tines that fold down or up and second rack lowers, etc. At the end of the day I or we want to have a quiet, energy efficient, roomy, dishwasher that cleans the heck out of our dishes. This one works for me. I also have some other lg products, so I trust their brand.

Sentence (English): This is a very nice, spacious counter depth refrigerator.
Comments (English): [ You asked for honest…well, here goes it ] || ---------------- || This is a very nice, spacious counter depth refrigerator. It performs as expected. Hopefully, it will perform as expected for 12+ years without issue. That is my expectation for a quality product from a quality manufacturer. Pluses: good storage in the refrigerator portion. Lots of door storage to be used as you please. We have lots of sauces and condiments so we use the door storage for that. There are two slim shelves on the bottom inside of the doors which are great for loose packets or sticks of butter. The adjustable shelf on the right is great for storing tall items below. This is where we keep milk, tea and other tall items. The deli drawer is nice and holds quite a lot, we wish that it was accessible (in some cleverly engineered manner) with only one door open. That would be a real plus! The veggie/produce drawers are ok. They don't hold a lot. Freezer storage is decent. I had a counter depth side by side previously, and I like the bottom storage better. It is performing as expected. The compressor and motor are quiet. This is really a big improvement compared to my previous unit. Cons: the finish is attractive and seems to be finger print resistant, BUT be prepared to treat the finish with kid gloves! The finish is thin. This is a decorative finish and not durable. This finish is not what made stainless steel the work horse of the kitchen. If you have kids, be prepared to have scratches, dings and dents. We have three adults in the house and are extremely careful and have issues. Do not ever push the freezer door closed with a knee or foot, I think it would be a problem. Use the handle. Overall, I think protecting and maintaining the finish will be difficult. The craft ice maker is a neat feature, but the spheres have a concave disc on the bottom. They are not fully formed. This significantly reduces the cool factor of the feature. The ice maker makes small cubes and not a lot of them. Our previous freezer made a lot of ice which was convenient for filling a small cooler or hosting company. Also, the latch to access the ice is made of plastic and plastic parts are always a risk for cracking. Let's see, a couple other small irritants: the door ajar bell comes on pretty quick. I'd prefer it come on after two minutes or more (I might be able to change this though, I just haven't looked into it.) There is a rattle when the doors shut from the items stored on the door shelves (this just bothers me, but is not an inherent problem with the design.)Overall, I am happy with my purchase. I only gave four stars because I think the finish will be hard to protect and the refrigerator needs to be a workhorse in a family kitchen as well as a handsome addition to a fab kitchen.

Lots of door storage to be used as you please. We have lots of sauces and condiments so we use the door storage for that. There are two slim shelves on the bottom inside of the doors which are great for loose packets or sticks of butter. The adjustable shelf on the right is great for storing tall items below. This is where we keep milk, tea and other tall items. The deli drawer is nice and holds quite a lot, we wish that it was accessible (in some cleverly engineered manner) with only one door open. That would be a real plus! The veggie/produce drawers are ok. They don't hold a lot. Freezer storage is decent. I had a counter depth side by side previously, and I like the bottom storage better. It is performing as expected. The compressor and motor are quiet. This is really a big improvement compared to my previous unit. Cons: the finish is attractive and seems to be finger print resistant, BUT be prepared to treat the finish with kid gloves! The finish is thin. This is a decorative finish and not durable. This finish is not what made stainless steel the work horse of the kitchen. If you have kids, be prepared to have scratches, dings and dents. We have three adults in the house and are extremely careful and have issues. Do not ever push the freezer door closed with a knee or foot, I think it would be a problem. Use the handle. Overall, I think protecting and maintaining the finish will be difficult. The craft ice maker is a neat feature, but the spheres have a concave disc on the bottom. They are not fully formed. This significantly reduces the cool factor of the feature. The ice maker makes small cubes and not a lot of them. Our previous freezer made a lot of ice which was convenient for filling a small cooler or hosting company. Also, the latch to access the ice is made of plastic and plastic parts are always a risk for cracking. Let's see, a couple other small irritants: the door ajar bell comes on pretty quick. I'd prefer it come on after two minutes or more (I might be able to change this though, I just haven't looked into it.) There is a rattle when the doors shut from the items stored on the door shelves (this just bothers me, but is not an inherent problem with the design.)Overall, I am happy with my purchase. I only gave four stars because I think the finish will be hard to protect and the refrigerator needs to be a workhorse in a family kitchen as well as a handsome addition to a fab kitchen.

Sentence (English): Recently purchased to replace a low Db dishwasher & this Kitchen Aid fits the bill.
Comments (English): [ Very Quiet ] || ---------------- || Recently purchased to replace a low Db dishwasher & this Kitchen Aid fits the bill. I cannot emphasize enough how quiet it is. It's a must in an open concept home. Dishes come out very clean, easy to operate, love the 3rd rack. Never knew how much I needed it before now. My only "complaint " is it came without a power cord and we had to put that on ourselves. It's like buying a car and you find out you have to put the gas pedal on yourself! Makes zero sense to me. The DW should come with a power cord & the customers who need to direct wire their DW can do it themselves or hire an electrician. I'm sure more than 75% of consumers who buy this product are using a power cord. The instruction manual was good and we supplemented it with YouTube videos. It needs a factory video though. I also like the stainless steel low fingerprint finish. It's very nice & resists fingerprints very well.

The second time at noon, it was enough to put bowls for five people in, and a small milk pot and a small casserole were also stuffed in, leaving only the stove and pot to clean. Sentence (English): I did several weeks of research before purchasing the Maytag MDB4949SKZ dishwasher and to say I am disappointed is an understatement.
Comments (English): [ DISAPPOINTED! READ before you BUY! ] || ---------------- || I did several weeks of research before purchasing the Maytag MDB4949SKZ dishwasher and to say I am disappointed is an understatement. This model had a 94% satisfaction rate when I purchased it, which has since dropped down to 74% in the past 2 weeks, but it is still the highest rated dishwasher in the $500-$700 price range. I have used the dishwasher 4 times, and I am going to return it. Having to buy online because the stores don't have models available is a challenge in itself. I expected a $600 dishwasher to have more settings to choose from besides Auto, Normal, Quick, and PowerBlast. I ran the silverware through 3 times using the PowerBlast AND Sani Rinse settings and they had more dirt and residue on them after the wash than before it. I used the highest temperature for washing and drying and there was sufficient rinse aid. Although there are silverware “slots” to keep each piece separate, the hole isn't big enough to accommodate my knife handles which had to be inserted upside-down. Also, my steak knives and marbled utensils were ruined, bleached out. The tines on the racks are way too narrow and close together and none of them fold down to accommodate large items, like a crockpot, for example. You would have to lay a large item down flat covering half the rack and limiting the number of dishes you could add around it. If you have deep soup/cereal bowls, you're out of luck. Forget about putting any pans in there. They advertise that you don't have to rinse the dishes before washing. Well, that is if you've just eaten within the hour. A pet bowl with leftover dried food does not come clean at all. This dishwasher is so narrow and limited in space, it would take 2 runs @ at 3 ½ hrs. each to clean dishes for a family of 6.

That said, this is a great dishwasher and I highly recommend it!

Comments (English): [ Very Quiet ] || ---------------- || Recently purchased to replace a low Db dishwasher & this Kitchen Aid fits the bill. I cannot emphasize enough how quiet it is. My only “complaint “ is it came without a power cord and we had to put that on ourselves. It's like buying a car and you find out you have to put the gas pedal on yourself! Makes zero sense to me. The DW should come with a power cord & the customers who need to direct wire their DW can do it themselves or hire an electrician. I'm sure more than 75% of consumers who buy this product are using a power cord. The instruction manual was good and we supplemented it with YouTube videos. It needs a factory video though. I also like the stainless steel low fingerprint finish. It's very nice & resists fingerprints very well.

Sentence (English): This takes a while to run a dishwasher load (on a thorough clean setting it takes upwards of 3 hours! )
Comments (English): [ Great Capacity, Great Clean, SUPER QUIET ] || ---------------- || This takes a while to run a dishwasher load (on a thorough clean setting it takes upwards of 3 hours! ) but the clean it puts down and the quiet of operation are fantastic. It's SO quiet I usually forget it's running altogether. Its eco-friendly ratings are high and I don't have a great way to test them but both electricity and water use are supposedly low and nothing we have seen suggests that's not true. The 3-row capacity is fantastic, it has great space in the top rack and the bottom racks have a lot of adjustability with prongs that lay down and utensil bins that are removable. The controls are pretty simple and it comes with a usage guide to clarify anything that isn't immediately apparent, no problems there. It has a timer that tells you how long your dish load will take which is nice. It connects to the LG ThinQ app to let you know about any important maintenance items and helps you find any parts or products it may need, like other LG appliances. All in all 5/5, would recommend splurging a little extra to get a high quality super-quiet dishwasher like this one. It's hard to explain just how little noise it makes without you experiencing for yourself.

Sentence (English): This is a good dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher, Inefficient design choices inside ] || ---------------- || This is a good dishwasher. The rating system won't let me give it 4.7 stars like I want to.It does what I expect, it's quiet, it looks nice, its easy to use. But there are some design choices and lack of instructions that I find irritating.First, the silverware caddy - specifically the slotted cover. Whoever designed this needs to be actually try using this and then be fired. The design needs to be redone - the angled design is totally inefficient, and leads to a lot of wasted space - all the little triangles along the edge are useless- not to mention it makes it harder to use - I spend way more time than I should trying to find a slot to make things fit into. My knives and forks only fit the largest slot, dessert forks and spoons the medium ones. Just make them all the same size. I would pay for a replacement caddy in a heartbeat if it were redesigned - but I shouldn't have to.Next, the top rack is just curious in design and function and needs to be re-thought. The lay-down approach to squeezing more cups in is interesting, but the shooters don't shoot enough water if the cup is super soiled. Anything that had tea in it needs a second cleaning - I just put tea-used cups on the second rack and they are fine. I use the top rack just for water glasses.The top rack silverware lay-down area on the right should be deeper and adjustable on its own so I could balance my load and accommodate the size of the second rack below.If the left side of the rack can be two inches deeper, why can't the right side so I could put cups there too? Also, without the plastic tray, the rack is useless, nothing stays put - the rack should be designed so the rack could be used without the plastic insert as well. I'd pay for a replacement and redesigned top rack.Next, while first learning to use the dishwasher, I found some odd arrows on the racks implying I could change them and adjust them (to change the angle of the tines on the bottom and middle rack, then to adjust the spacing on some of the tines on the bottom rack). These aren't mentioned in the instructions. For that matter, the instructions are next too useless - and the most important info is in the dowloadable one - but wait, Kitchenaid doesn't have the manual on its website, so I had to find it on a third party site.Next, as I'm always pressing the buttons when I close the door, I think a power button would be useful, so the control buttons wouldn't respond unless I power the unit on.Lastly, this is more of an annoyance, if "Pro wash" uses the sensor to determine the dirtyness of the dishes and adjusts the cycles", why isn't the sensor used all the time or in "normal" wash. Especially since Pro wash uses twice the amount of water.Some pros - I am able to put at least 25 percent more dishes in this simply because of the ability to adjust the spacing and angle of tines on the bottom and middle rack. The overall cleanliness of my dishes are better than my former dishwasher and the dishes are actually dry as well.Would I purchase the same dishwasher? Yes. It does a good job and I'm happy with it and easily work around the annoyances.Was it worth the price? This one depends on what your goals are - I wanted an American company. I wanted a brand that is actually serviceable and in-stock. It is impossible to get any service locally on my former Samsung washer (the nearest service center is 2000 miles away) and no local repair people would deal with Samsung - they even chuckled and said, "sorry, not Samsung".However, I was looking at an equivalent LG model and it was over 25% less in cost with more (and interesting) features - and my LG-made frig and stove have been fine but I went with the KitchenAid in the end. I also like the minimalistic straight pull-bar design.

Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || After repairing the control panel on a "high end" dishwasher and having it break again a year later we decided we were done with that brand. Bosch is known for making great dishwashers so we went with the 500 series. We liked the auto open feature on this model. It is EXTREMELY quiet and can be run during the daytime without any bothersome noise. It holds SO MANY plates, bowls, and glasses. With our previous dishwashers, we ran them daily because they were out of space. With the Bosch we only run our dishwasher every 2 days. The drawers glide very smoothly and we like having the 3rd rack.There are only 2 cons I can think of- it is harder to load larger items like pots, pans and large bowls. Also the stainless steel finish doesn't seem to be fingerprint proof. I have to wipe the front of the dishwasher several times per week. Overall, really satisfied with our purchase!

Sentence (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. I recommend it because I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang experience group event.

Sentence (English): My husband really likes it.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Sentence (English): Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Sentence (English): I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Sentence (English): Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Sentence (English): The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Sentence (English): Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Sentence (English): Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Sentence (English): Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Sentence (English): It shows a new world.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Sentence (English): I recommend it because I think the price is cheap.
Comments (English): My kitchen is very small compared to others, so I thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't bring myself to buy one. I bought it through a trial group and it's a new world. *My husband really likes it. Let me briefly summarize what I felt after using it for a few days. First of all, since we are a family of three, we don't use large pots and frying pans often, so the size of the dishwasher for three people was perfect. Above all, as I mentioned above, the kitchen is small, so even if there was a large dishwasher, there was no place to put it. I didn't know what non-installation meant, but when I actually received it and tried to install it, it wasn't a separate installation, but rather a drain and a drain to the sink. When you turn it on and pour water into the inlet, the machine notifies you when it's full. I want to fill it with water right away, but that's far from it. What are the functions? Standard wash - 64 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. The lowest water usage and suitable for washing after a typical meal Powerful wash - 81 minutes *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for washing oily or heavily soiled dishes Eco wash - 80 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled and simple washing Quick wash - 29 minutes *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for dishes that are easy to wash and do not require drying, short washing time. Steam sterilization - 64 minutes *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam, sterilization possible, suitable for dishes that require sterilization such as baby bottles *5L of water is used. 6g of detergent is used, but I think you can use the correct amount. Things I felt while using the dishwasher Pros * It washes well * It saves water * You can do other things while washing dishes * The design is pretty * The electricity bill is lower than you think (personal opinion) Cons * You can't put in large dishes * The price of the special detergent * It takes a while to wash In conclusion, there are people who have never used it, but there are absolutely no people who have only used it once. I finally understood why people use it. I received the product as a member of the experience group and am writing this review, but I am the type who honestly writes that products that really don't work are really bad (they use blind processing). It shows a new world. It is for 3 people, but it seems good for 2 people? I think it would be good for someone who lives alone to be able to wash dishes very comfortably. I recommend it because I think the price is cheap. If you are looking for a dishwasher, a new world will open up if you buy it. Comments (English): [ It's really comfortable. I wish I had bought it sooner. ] || ---------------- || It's vacation, so the kids are home, and since we eat, clean up, and repeat all day, doing the dishes is so boring and hard. After I cook breakfast, lunch, and dinner, there's a mountain of dishes to wash, and I think I spend at least an hour standing in the kitchen, and even if I buy food or snacks for the kids to reduce the dishes, there are a lot of cooking utensils and dishes to throw away, and sometimes my friends come over to the house and take out all the dishes and cups ~~ Is there a dishwasher that I can put in my house? I looked into it! I found a dishwasher that's perfect for my family! There's no house without a dishwasher these days! I used a dishwasher for the first time in 19 years, and wow, my quality of life has changed! My eldest child will be joining the military soon, so I live with three people, so a 3-person dishwasher seems just right. I can just put the dishes away after eating and do other things during that time! It's so convenient! My parents-in-law are old and only have two of them, and they work outside and come back often, so I thought I should buy them a dishwasher, but this size is also great. Since the apartment is small, a large dishwasher takes up a lot of space, but this product is a mini dishwasher, so it doesn't take up much space, doesn't require separate installation, and only uses a set amount of water when washing dishes, so it seems economical. I washed the dishes for the past few days and they were clean, and since it was washed at a high temperature of 72 degrees, it steam sterilized and even had a fan, it was perfect! There were no stains, and the dishes were sparkling clean, and the steam sterilization worked well, so the dishes were hot! Even if you hand wash the dishes with oil in hot water, the grease doesn't come off easily ~~ It washes the dishes well! It even cleans the spaces between the lids of lunch boxes, so I don't have to use a brush. Now I'm free from washing dishes! I went to my sister's house that has a large dishwasher ~ Even after eating all day, the large dishwasher didn't come out enough dishes to fit in it, so I felt bad about emptying it and washing it, and since I left it in the dishwasher for a long time until the dishes came out, food got stuck and wouldn't come off, so she said she didn't use it anymore. Although the media is small, the dishwasher performance is good, and it's convenient to fill it up and wash the dishes as they come out! It also recycles the hot water that comes out at high pressure, so it's useful to receive it and use it to clean the drain! I think it would be easy for people living alone, single-person households, newlyweds, and elderly couples to use! I'm also freed from washing dishes and it's so convenient ^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I wish I had bought it sooner. ] || ---------------- || It's vacation, so the kids are home, and since we eat, clean up, and repeat all day, doing the dishes is so boring and hard. After I cook breakfast, lunch, and dinner, there's a mountain of dishes to wash, and I think I spend at least an hour standing in the kitchen, and even if I buy food or snacks for the kids to reduce the dishes, there are a lot of cooking utensils and dishes to throw away, and sometimes my friends come over to the house and take out all the dishes and cups ~~ Is there a dishwasher that I can put in my house? I looked into it! I found a dishwasher that's perfect for my family! There's no house without a dishwasher these days! I used a dishwasher for the first time in 19 years, and wow, my quality of life has changed! My eldest child will be joining the military soon, so I live with three people, so a 3-person dishwasher seems just right. I can just put the dishes away after eating and do other things during that time! It's so convenient! My parents-in-law are old and only have two of them, and they work outside and come back often, so I thought I should buy them a dishwasher, but this size is also great. Since the apartment is small, a large dishwasher takes up a lot of space, but this product is a mini dishwasher, so it doesn't take up much space, doesn't require separate installation, and only uses a set amount of water when washing dishes, so it seems economical. There were no stains, and the dishes were sparkling clean, and the steam sterilization worked well, so the dishes were hot! Even if you hand wash the dishes with oil in hot water, the grease doesn't come off easily ~~ It washes the dishes well! Comments (English): [ Small but powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to these people. People who need a dishwasher but move often. People who are reluctant to drill holes. People with small families or those who do not have enough space for a dishwasher. People with two people. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally eat a lot of delivery food. I like drinking tea, so I drink tea often, so I end up with a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really worried about whether to buy a dishwasher, and I ended up buying it at a great opportunity. ^^ There is no need to worry because it is not installed. ^^ The box was bigger than I thought. When I opened it, it was a dishwasher that is a reasonable size for 3 people. ^^ Of course, a frying pan or pot does not fit. It is the same for a 6-person dishwasher. There are various washing cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, steam). I put in cups, spoons, plates, rice bowls, and cooking utensils and turned it on in standard mode. It took about an hour. Oh~~ You have to turn it on and add water to avoid a malfunction. It says it doesn't come out. Also, check if it's level. Since it's a structure that pours water and turns it, it's a bit noisier than when the water supply is connected. I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain pipe in the dishwasher, so I rinse it with a larva and then put it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be looked down on^^ It sprays water up and down to wash every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. In particular, the cups are washed much better than when you wash them by hand. When the washing is complete, it operates for 75.5 hours of air drying until you open the door. You can hear a humming sound and the air is blowing. I open it halfway and open the door to dry the inside. I use a water tank first. It's not too much of a hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can use a faucet to pour water directly or install it yourself. When the water in the internal water tank is full, a notification sound will sound and you can stop the water supply. It's possible to wash at high temperature of 72 degrees and also sterilize with steam, so it seems like it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person one. People who are reluctant to drill holes. People with small families or those who do not have enough space for a dishwasher. People with two people. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally eat a lot of delivery food. I like drinking tea, so I drink tea often, so I end up with a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really worried about whether to buy a dishwasher, and I ended up buying it at a great opportunity. ^^ There is no need to worry because it is not installed. ^^ The box was bigger than I thought. Oh~~ You have to turn it on and add water to avoid a malfunction. It says it doesn't come out. Also, check if it's level. Since it's a structure that pours water and turns it, it's a bit noisier than when the water supply is connected. I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain pipe in the dishwasher, so I rinse it with a larva and then put it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be looked down on^^ It sprays water up and down to wash every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. In particular, the cups are washed much better than when you wash them by hand. When the washing is complete, it operates for 75.5 hours of air drying until you open the door. You can hear a humming sound and the air is blowing. I open it halfway and open the door to dry the inside. I use a water tank first. It's not too much of a hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can use a faucet to pour water directly or install it yourself. When the water in the internal water tank is full, a notification sound will sound and you can stop the water supply. Sentence (English): People with two people.
Comments (English): [ Small but powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to these people. People who need a dishwasher but move often. People who are reluctant to drill holes. People with small families or those who do not have enough space for a dishwasher. People with two people. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally eat a lot of delivery food. I like drinking tea, so I drink tea often, so I end up with a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really worried about whether to buy a dishwasher, and I ended up buying it at a great opportunity. ^^ There is no need to worry because it is not installed. ^^ The box was bigger than I thought. When I opened it, it was a dishwasher that is a reasonable size for 3 people. ^^ Of course, a frying pan or pot does not fit. It is the same for a 6-person dishwasher. There are various washing cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, steam). I put in cups, spoons, plates, rice bowls, and cooking utensils and turned it on in standard mode. It took about an hour. Oh~~ You have to turn it on and add water to avoid a malfunction. It says it doesn't come out. Also, check if it's level. Since it's a structure that pours water and turns it, it's a bit noisier than when the water supply is connected. I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain pipe in the dishwasher, so I rinse it with a larva and then put it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be looked down on^^ It sprays water up and down to wash every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. In particular, the cups are washed much better than when you wash them by hand. When the washing is complete, it operates for 75.5 hours of air drying until you open the door. You can hear a humming sound and the air is blowing. I open it halfway and open the door to dry the inside. I use a water tank first. It's not too much of a hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can use a faucet to pour water directly or install it yourself. When the water in the internal water tank is full, a notification sound will sound and you can stop the water supply. It's possible to wash at high temperature of 72 degrees and also sterilize with steam, so it seems like it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles.
