Comments (English): [ Small but powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to these people. People who need a dishwasher but move often. People who are reluctant to drill holes. People with small families or those who do not have enough space for a dishwasher. People with two people. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally eat a lot of delivery food. I like drinking tea, so I drink tea often, so I end up with a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really worried about whether to buy a dishwasher, and I ended up buying it at a great opportunity. ^^ There is no need to worry because it is not installed. ^^ The box was bigger than I thought. When I opened it, it was a dishwasher that is a reasonable size for 3 people. ^^ Of course, a frying pan or pot does not fit. It is the same for a 6-person dishwasher. There are various washing cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, steam). I put in cups, spoons, plates, rice bowls, and cooking utensils and turned it on in standard mode. It took about an hour. Oh~~ You have to turn it on and add water to avoid a malfunction. It says it doesn't come out. Also, check if it's level. Since it's a structure that pours water and turns it, it's a bit noisier than when the water supply is connected. I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain pipe in the dishwasher, so I rinse it with a larva and then put it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be looked down on^^ It sprays water up and down to wash every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. In particular, the cups are washed much better than when you wash them by hand. When the washing is complete, it operates for 75.5 hours of air drying until you open the door. You can hear a humming sound and the air is blowing. I open it halfway and open the door to dry the inside. I use a water tank first. It's not too much of a hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can use a faucet to pour water directly or install it yourself. When the water in the internal water tank is full, a notification sound will sound and you can stop the water supply. Comments (English): [ Small but powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to these people. People who need a dishwasher but move often. People who are reluctant to drill holes. People with small families or those who do not have enough space for a dishwasher. People with two people. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally eat a lot of delivery food. I like drinking tea, so I drink tea often, so I end up with a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really worried about whether to buy a dishwasher, and I ended up buying it at a great opportunity. ^^ There is no need to worry because it is not installed. ^^ The box was bigger than I thought. When I opened it, it was a dishwasher that is a reasonable size for 3 people. ^^ Of course, a frying pan or pot does not fit. It is the same for a 6-person dishwasher. There are various washing cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, steam). I put in cups, spoons, plates, rice bowls, and cooking utensils and turned it on in standard mode. It took about an hour. Oh~~ You have to turn it on and add water to avoid a malfunction. It says it doesn't come out. Also, check if it's level. Since it's a structure that pours water and turns it, it's a bit noisier than when the water supply is connected. I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain pipe in the dishwasher, so I rinse it with a larva and then put it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be looked down on^^ It sprays water up and down to wash every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. In particular, the cups are washed much better than when you wash them by hand. When the washing is complete, it operates for 75.5 hours of air drying until you open the door. You can hear a humming sound and the air is blowing. I open it halfway and open the door to dry the inside. I use a water tank first. It's not too much of a hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can use a faucet to pour water directly or install it yourself. When the water in the internal water tank is full, a notification sound will sound and you can stop the water supply. It's possible to wash at high temperature of 72 degrees and also sterilize with steam, so it seems like it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. Since it's a structure that pours water and turns it, it's a bit noisier than when the water supply is connected. I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain pipe in the dishwasher, so I rinse it with a larva and then put it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be looked down on^^ It sprays water up and down to wash every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. In particular, the cups are washed much better than when you wash them by hand. When the washing is complete, it operates for 75.5 hours of air drying until you open the door. You can hear a humming sound and the air is blowing. I open it halfway and open the door to dry the inside. I use a water tank first. Comments (English): [ Small but powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to these people. People who need a dishwasher but move often. People who are reluctant to drill holes. People with small families or those who do not have enough space for a dishwasher. People with two people. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally eat a lot of delivery food. I like drinking tea, so I drink tea often, so I end up with a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really worried about whether to buy a dishwasher, and I ended up buying it at a great opportunity. ^^ There is no need to worry because it is not installed. ^^ The box was bigger than I thought. When I opened it, it was a dishwasher that is a reasonable size for 3 people. ^^ Of course, a frying pan or pot does not fit. It is the same for a 6-person dishwasher. There are various washing cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, steam). I put in cups, spoons, plates, rice bowls, and cooking utensils and turned it on in standard mode. It took about an hour. Oh~~ You have to turn it on and add water to avoid a malfunction. It says it doesn't come out. Also, check if it's level. Since it's a structure that pours water and turns it, it's a bit noisier than when the water supply is connected. I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain pipe in the dishwasher, so I rinse it with a larva and then put it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be looked down on^^ It sprays water up and down to wash every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. In particular, the cups are washed much better than when you wash them by hand. When the washing is complete, it operates for 75.5 hours of air drying until you open the door. You can hear a humming sound and the air is blowing. I open it halfway and open the door to dry the inside. I use a water tank first. It's not too much of a hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can use a faucet to pour water directly or install it yourself. When the water in the internal water tank is full, a notification sound will sound and you can stop the water supply. It's possible to wash at high temperature of 72 degrees and also sterilize with steam, so it seems like it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. Among the accessories, it also came with a drip tray and a plate to put water in? Third, it should not be too big or too small. Fourth, it should have a quick mode. Fifth, the color of the dishwasher should not stand out too much. Sixth, it should be able to remove grease easily. After thinking about many things, I found that this product fit almost half of the criteria. But it weighed about 13? 14 kg. I was surprised by the weight when I lifted it. If you use the quick mode, you cannot use the drying function separately, so after about 29 minutes, you have to open the dishwasher door to dry the dishes. It is a bit inconvenient because you have to pour the water yourself. 2. It does not break down unless you use a detergent specifically for dishwashers. 3. Comments (English): [ A pretty decent dishwasher ] || ---------------- || In this busy world, washing dishes after meals is so annoying and bothersome, so I bought a dishwasher, which is popular these days. My first impression was that the box was very big, so I was a little surprised, but it was carefully packaged to protect the contents. The biggest advantage of this product is that it is installation-free, so there is no need to install it like built-in furniture. Just place it wherever you want in the kitchen and connect the drain, and you're done! And the shelves inside the washer are easy to assemble. You need to refill water for operation, and you need to fill the dedicated container about 3 times. After filling the water, it seems to take about 30 minutes to start the machine. Another advantage of this product is that you can see the washing process from the outside. You can see the washing process from the inside, so you can see that it is being washed thoroughly. I am completely satisfied with the result. Even dishes and bowls that were quite oily are washed cleanly. Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Couple's 3-person household, honest pros and cons, real user review, additional photos ] || ---------------- || This is my first time using a dishwasher. I've heard that dishwashers are good, but since it's a rented house and an old apartment, there's no built-in, and the kitchen is small, about 21 pyeong, so I didn't even think about a dishwasher, but I thought I could use a dishwasher that can be installed without a hole for 3 people, and it's easy to install because it's not a hole. It's good because it's easy to carry when moving, and my husband and I are both clumsy, but we just read the manual once and followed the instructions, so we installed it without any errors and have already used it several times. Since we use a lot of spoons and plates, we only keep a large frying pan, pot, and side dish container, and only keep a simple cup, plate, and spoon set. I thought it would be enough to turn it once a day for 3 people, but I have to turn it after every meal. I think the 3-person standard is more suitable for overseas than domestic dishes. It seems a bit difficult to stack Korean dishes without them closing. If you have a flat plate and chopsticks, it seems like it could be enough for 3 or more people. On weekdays, I almost only use plates and chopsticks, and my husband only eats rice once at night, so if you separate the ones that go in the dishwasher, I think you can do it once a day. Since I wash dishes with water a lot, I use a lot of water and my hands get sore, but now I can do a big one at once, so it definitely saves time. Pros and cons that I felt while using it 1. You have to fill the water every time you turn it on. We don't have a faucet, so we pour it into the large water cup that came with it about 3 times. 2. You can't change the position or pillar where you can put the dishes, so you have to think carefully so that they don't overlap. If you don't overlap them, they won't fit as much as you think. 3. 1 hour in standard mode may seem excessive compared to the amount of dishes you wash, but if you consider that it takes that much time and the electricity bill is low, it's worth considering. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. Flat dishes, spoons and chopsticks, and simple cups are okay, but if you put in dishes with grooves or soup bowls, it is not good to secure the space. If you run the dishwasher for two people every meal, it is okay, but if you run it once a day, I recommend it for one person who eats at home, and for one or two people who do the dishes right away, it will not be very convenient. Another disadvantage I felt is that since it is a powdered detergent, there is a lot of powder left at the bottom of the dishwasher like powdered detergent in a washing machine. Comments (English): [ Couple's 3-person household, honest pros and cons, real user review, additional photos ] || ---------------- || This is my first time using a dishwasher. I've heard that dishwashers are good, but since it's a rented house and an old apartment, there's no built-in, and the kitchen is small, about 21 pyeong, so I didn't even think about a dishwasher, but I thought I could use a dishwasher that can be installed without a hole for 3 people, and it's easy to install because it's not a hole. It's good because it's easy to carry when moving, and my husband and I are both clumsy, but we just read the manual once and followed the instructions, so we installed it without any errors and have already used it several times. Since we use a lot of spoons and plates, we only keep a large frying pan, pot, and side dish container, and only keep a simple cup, plate, and spoon set. I thought it would be enough to turn it once a day for 3 people, but I have to turn it after every meal. I think the 3-person standard is more suitable for overseas than domestic dishes. It seems a bit difficult to stack Korean dishes without them closing. If you have a flat plate and chopsticks, it seems like it could be enough for 3 or more people. On weekdays, I almost only use plates and chopsticks, and my husband only eats rice once at night, so if you separate the ones that go in the dishwasher, I think you can do it once a day. Since I wash dishes with water a lot, I use a lot of water and my hands get sore, but now I can do a big one at once, so it definitely saves time. Pros and cons that I felt while using it 1. You have to fill the water every time you turn it on. We don't have a faucet, so we pour it into the large water cup that came with it about 3 times. 2. You can't change the position or pillar where you can put the dishes, so you have to think carefully so that they don't overlap. If you don't overlap them, they won't fit as much as you think. 3. 1 hour in standard mode may seem excessive compared to the amount of dishes you wash, but if you consider that it takes that much time and the electricity bill is low, it's worth considering. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. Flat dishes, spoons and chopsticks, and simple cups are okay, but if you put in dishes with grooves or soup bowls, it is not good to secure the space. If you run the dishwasher for two people every meal, it is okay, but if you run it once a day, I recommend it for one person who eats at home, and for one or two people who do the dishes right away, it will not be very convenient. Another disadvantage I felt is that since it is a powdered detergent, there is a lot of powder left at the bottom of the dishwasher like powdered detergent in a washing machine. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. It's good because it's easy to carry when moving, and my husband and I are both clumsy, but we just read the manual once and followed the instructions, so we installed it without any errors and have already used it several times. Since we use a lot of spoons and plates, we only keep a large frying pan, pot, and side dish container, and only keep a simple cup, plate, and spoon set. I thought it would be enough to turn it once a day for 3 people, but I have to turn it after every meal. I think the 3-person standard is more suitable for overseas than domestic dishes. It seems a bit difficult to stack Korean dishes without them closing. If you have a flat plate and chopsticks, it seems like it could be enough for 3 or more people. On weekdays, I almost only use plates and chopsticks, and my husband only eats rice once at night, so if you separate the ones that go in the dishwasher, I think you can do it once a day. Since I wash dishes with water a lot, I use a lot of water and my hands get sore, but now I can do a big one at once, so it definitely saves time. Pros and cons that I felt while using it 1. You have to fill the water every time you turn it on. We don't have a faucet, so we pour it into the large water cup that came with it about 3 times. 2. You can't change the position or pillar where you can put the dishes, so you have to think carefully so that they don't overlap. If you don't overlap them, they won't fit as much as you think. 3. 1 hour in standard mode may seem excessive compared to the amount of dishes you wash, but if you consider that it takes that much time and the electricity bill is low, it's worth considering. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. Flat dishes, spoons and chopsticks, and simple cups are okay, but if you put in dishes with grooves or soup bowls, it is not good to secure the space. If you run the dishwasher for two people every meal, it is okay, but if you run it once a day, I recommend it for one person who eats at home, and for one or two people who do the dishes right away, it will not be very convenient. Another disadvantage I felt is that since it is a powdered detergent, there is a lot of powder left at the bottom of the dishwasher like powdered detergent in a washing machine. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. I've heard that dishwashers are good, but since it's a rented house and an old apartment, there's no built-in, and the kitchen is small, about 21 pyeong, so I didn't even think about a dishwasher, but I thought I could use a dishwasher that can be installed without a hole for 3 people, and it's easy to install because it's not a hole. It's good because it's easy to carry when moving, and my husband and I are both clumsy, but we just read the manual once and followed the instructions, so we installed it without any errors and have already used it several times. Since we use a lot of spoons and plates, we only keep a large frying pan, pot, and side dish container, and only keep a simple cup, plate, and spoon set. I thought it would be enough to turn it once a day for 3 people, but I have to turn it after every meal. I think the 3-person standard is more suitable for overseas than domestic dishes. It seems a bit difficult to stack Korean dishes without them closing. If you have a flat plate and chopsticks, it seems like it could be enough for 3 or more people. On weekdays, I almost only use plates and chopsticks, and my husband only eats rice once at night, so if you separate the ones that go in the dishwasher, I think you can do it once a day. Since I wash dishes with water a lot, I use a lot of water and my hands get sore, but now I can do a big one at once, so it definitely saves time. Pros and cons that I felt while using it 1. You have to fill the water every time you turn it on. We don't have a faucet, so we pour it into the large water cup that came with it about 3 times. 2. You can't change the position or pillar where you can put the dishes, so you have to think carefully so that they don't overlap. If you don't overlap them, they won't fit as much as you think. 3. 1 hour in standard mode may seem excessive compared to the amount of dishes you wash, but if you consider that it takes that much time and the electricity bill is low, it's worth considering. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. Flat dishes, spoons and chopsticks, and simple cups are okay, but if you put in dishes with grooves or soup bowls, it is not good to secure the space. If you run the dishwasher for two people every meal, it is okay, but if you run it once a day, I recommend it for one person who eats at home, and for one or two people who do the dishes right away, it will not be very convenient. Another disadvantage I felt is that since it is a powdered detergent, there is a lot of powder left at the bottom of the dishwasher like powdered detergent in a washing machine. I thought it would be enough to turn it once a day for 3 people, but I have to turn it after every meal. I think the 3-person standard is more suitable for overseas than domestic dishes. It seems a bit difficult to stack Korean dishes without them closing. If you have a flat plate and chopsticks, it seems like it could be enough for 3 or more people. On weekdays, I almost only use plates and chopsticks, and my husband only eats rice once at night, so if you separate the ones that go in the dishwasher, I think you can do it once a day. Since I wash dishes with water a lot, I use a lot of water and my hands get sore, but now I can do a big one at once, so it definitely saves time. Pros and cons that I felt while using it 1. You have to fill the water every time you turn it on. We don't have a faucet, so we pour it into the large water cup that came with it about 3 times. 2. You can't change the position or pillar where you can put the dishes, so you have to think carefully so that they don't overlap. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. Flat dishes, spoons and chopsticks, and simple cups are okay, but if you put in dishes with grooves or soup bowls, it is not good to secure the space. If you run the dishwasher for two people every meal, it is okay, but if you run it once a day, I recommend it for one person who eats at home, and for one or two people who do the dishes right away, it will not be very convenient. Another disadvantage I felt is that since it is a powdered detergent, there is a lot of powder left at the bottom of the dishwasher like powdered detergent in a washing machine. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. You can't change the position or pillar where you can put the dishes, so you have to think carefully so that they don't overlap. If you don't overlap them, they won't fit as much as you think. 3. 1 hour in standard mode may seem excessive compared to the amount of dishes you wash, but if you consider that it takes that much time and the electricity bill is low, it's worth considering. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. Flat dishes, spoons and chopsticks, and simple cups are okay, but if you put in dishes with grooves or soup bowls, it is not good to secure the space. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping.  사용후 느낀점은 이가격대의 성능과 디자인 마감 아주 만족해요. 추천드립니다.  ✅✅✅✅제 솔직한 리뷰가 도움이 되셨다면 도움이되요! ! 부탁드려요✅✅  ✅✅추가사용후기  식세기 전용그릇 구매하는게아닌 기존 한국식그릇 사용할경우 겹치지않게 쌓기가 굉장히 어려워요. 납작한 그릇과 수저젓가락,간단컵정도는 괜찮지만 홈이있는 그릇,국그릇 넣게되면 공관확보가 안좋아요. 2인기준 매끼 식세기돌리다면 괜찮지만 하루 몰아서 한번돌리는경우는 집에서 집밥먹는1인 추천드리고, 1~2인가구***** 설거지금방하는분들은 크게 편함이 와닿지 않으실거예요. 또 추가적으로 느낀단점이 가루알약세제라그런지 세탁기 가루세제남듯이 식세기 하단에 가루들이 많이남아요. 추가사진첨부 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. It's good because it's easy to carry when moving, and my husband and I are both clumsy, but we just read the manual once and followed the instructions, so we installed it without any errors and have already used it several times. Since we use a lot of spoons and plates, we only keep a large frying pan, pot, and side dish container, and only keep a simple cup, plate, and spoon set. I thought it would be enough to turn it once a day for 3 people, but I have to turn it after every meal. I think the 3-person standard is more suitable for overseas than domestic dishes. It seems a bit difficult to stack Korean dishes without them closing. If you have a flat plate and chopsticks, it seems like it could be enough for 3 or more people. On weekdays, I almost only use plates and chopsticks, and my husband only eats rice once at night, so if you separate the ones that go in the dishwasher, I think you can do it once a day. Since I wash dishes with water a lot, I use a lot of water and my hands get sore, but now I can do a big one at once, so it definitely saves time. Pros and cons that I felt while using it 1. You have to fill the water every time you turn it on. We don't have a faucet, so we pour it into the large water cup that came with it about 3 times. 2. You can't change the position or pillar where you can put the dishes, so you have to think carefully so that they don't overlap. If you don't overlap them, they won't fit as much as you think. 3. 1 hour in standard mode may seem excessive compared to the amount of dishes you wash, but if you consider that it takes that much time and the electricity bill is low, it's worth considering. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. Flat dishes, spoons and chopsticks, and simple cups are okay, but if you put in dishes with grooves or soup bowls, it is not good to secure the space. If you run the dishwasher for two people every meal, it is okay, but if you run it once a day, I recommend it for one person who eats at home, and for one or two people who do the dishes right away, it will not be very convenient. Another disadvantage I felt is that since it is a powdered detergent, there is a lot of powder left at the bottom of the dishwasher like powdered detergent in a washing machine. I've heard that dishwashers are good, but since it's a rented house and an old apartment, there's no built-in, and the kitchen is small, about 21 pyeong, so I didn't even think about a dishwasher, but I thought I could use a dishwasher that can be installed without a hole for 3 people, and it's easy to install because it's not a hole. It's good because it's easy to carry when moving, and my husband and I are both clumsy, but we just read the manual once and followed the instructions, so we installed it without any errors and have already used it several times. Since we use a lot of spoons and plates, we only keep a large frying pan, pot, and side dish container, and only keep a simple cup, plate, and spoon set. I thought it would be enough to turn it once a day for 3 people, but I have to turn it after every meal. I think the 3-person standard is more suitable for overseas than domestic dishes. It seems a bit difficult to stack Korean dishes without them closing. If you have a flat plate and chopsticks, it seems like it could be enough for 3 or more people. On weekdays, I almost only use plates and chopsticks, and my husband only eats rice once at night, so if you separate the ones that go in the dishwasher, I think you can do it once a day. Since I wash dishes with water a lot, I use a lot of water and my hands get sore, but now I can do a big one at once, so it definitely saves time. Pros and cons that I felt while using it 1. You have to fill the water every time you turn it on. We don't have a faucet, so we pour it into the large water cup that came with it about 3 times. 2. You can't change the position or pillar where you can put the dishes, so you have to think carefully so that they don't overlap. If you don't overlap them, they won't fit as much as you think. 3. 1 hour in standard mode may seem excessive compared to the amount of dishes you wash, but if you consider that it takes that much time and the electricity bill is low, it's worth considering. But it definitely uses less water than I do. I also use the right amount of detergent, so I don't overuse it, which I think is good for the environment. In my house, it felt like it had to foam up a lot to clean, so it was hard to use a little detergent. Also, it would have been nice if there was a device that would open the lid halfway when I finished washing the dishes, but it only opens wide, so it's very inconvenient to open it in a small kitchen. The noise is also loud, as if there's a washing machine right next to it, so I don't recommend it to people who are sensitive to noise, and I recommend turning it on when you go out. In my house, the TV, music, and rain are on, and since I sleep, the sound of the dishwasher running doesn't feel noisy. Rather, I like the sound of water at the same interval. Other than that, the design is better than I thought, and the power cord and drain hose are long, so I think I'll be able to use it for a while unless it breaks down. And since it was my first dishwasher, I didn't know whether to use powder detergent, liquid detergent, or tablet detergent, but since it just falls inside when you put it in and close the door anyway, I think it doesn't matter what you use as long as you get the right amount. I thought the detergent came as a sample, but when I tried to use it, there was only the dehumidifier that came with it, so I went to E-Mart and bought it in a hurry. The detergent in the general necessities section was 3,000 won for 600g, so I looked for a cheap one, and the no-brand detergent was 3,000 won for the same amount! They sell it. If the detergent is expensive, it's better than the price, but if it's 3,000 won for 60 times, I think it'll run the dishwasher without any burden. Also, it seems like my child is specialized in washing baby bottles, so I'm sad that my family just stopped using baby bottles. I washed more than 10 baby bottles a day, so it would be really good to give it as a gift or buy it as a baby bottle washer. If you know about this product, I think it would be a must-have for mothers who have given birth, more than a formula pot. My impressions after using it are that I'm very satisfied with the performance and design finish at this price range. I recommend it. If you found my honest review helpful, please help! Additional review If you use existing Korean-style dishes instead of purchasing dishwasher-specific dishes, it is very difficult to stack them without overlapping. Flat dishes, spoons and chopsticks, and simple cups are okay, but if you put in dishes with grooves or soup bowls, it is not good to secure the space. If you run the dishwasher for two people every meal, it is okay, but if you run it once a day, I recommend it for one person who eats at home, and for one or two people who do the dishes right away, it will not be very convenient. Another disadvantage I felt is that since it is a powdered detergent, there is a lot of powder left at the bottom of the dishwasher like powdered detergent in a washing machine.  사용후 느낀점은 이가격대의 성능과 디자인 마감 아주 만족해요. 추천드립니다.  ✅✅✅✅제 솔직한 리뷰가 도움이 되셨다면 도움이되요! ! 부탁드려요✅✅  ✅✅추가사용후기  식세기 전용그릇 구매하는게아닌 기존 한국식그릇 사용할경우 겹치지않게 쌓기가 굉장히 어려워요. 납작한 그릇과 수저젓가락,간단컵정도는 괜찮지만 홈이있는 그릇,국그릇 넣게되면 공관확보가 안좋아요. 2인기준 매끼 식세기돌리다면 괜찮지만 하루 몰아서 한번돌리는경우는 집에서 집밥먹는1인 추천드리고, 1~2인가구***** 설거지금방하는분들은 크게 편함이 와닿지 않으실거예요. 또 추가적으로 느낀단점이 가루알약세제라그런지 세탁기 가루세제남듯이 식세기 하단에 가루들이 많이남아요. 추가사진첨부 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

There is also a detergent that costs 8,000 won for 100 uses. It cleans well enough. I don't know how much the electricity bill will be, but I'm sure it's worth it if you think about saving time. It's so clean! Now, a water purifier, an automatic coffee machine, and a dishwasher are three things that have become essential in the kitchen.

(진짜 초 편할듯) 3인 가구가 사용하기엔 용량이 작습니다. 밥그릇 2개, 국그릇 2개 넣고 접시류 몇개 넣고나면 빈공간이 그리 많지 남지 않습니다. 도마도 여기 들어가는 사이즈로 사용중입니다 완전 깨끗! 이제 주방에 정수기, 자동커피머신, 식세기 이 세가지는 필수가 되어버렸네요

Sentence (English): These days, I'm so busy that after finishing work, taking care of the three kids, and putting them to bed, I end up doing the dishes after midnight.
Comments (English): These days, I'm so busy that after finishing work, taking care of the three kids, and putting them to bed, I end up doing the dishes after midnight. I don't know about anything else, but I'm serious about eating and I'm obsessed with dishwashing, so I never let someone else do the dishes for me. ^^ When I go to a restaurant and the dishes are stained or the spoons are dirty, the food really loses its flavor. I'm a bit picky. ^^ My friend next to me kept saying that dishwashers are so convenient and good, and I just ignored them~ My older sister is using one too~~ But I stubbornly insisted on washing by hand, but I've been so busy lately that my ears are starting to get a little thin. Then I came across the Media Mini dishwasher~ Oh~~ This is a whole new world. At first, I thought it wouldn't be that big since it's for three people, but I was really surprised when I saw the box~~~ I opened the box with anticipation~ Hmm~~ I really like the luxurious and pretty design. I carefully placed it on the sink, but wow~~ It's bigger than I thought and it's taking up too much space~^^ First of all, I wonder if it will clean well? I was hesitant and only put in 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, and 5 small plates~~ Hmm. Personally, the plate trays are supposed to be inserted at an angle, but since my small plates are sunken, each compartment felt a bit cramped~ I think they are installed closely together so that a lot can be inserted, but because they are inserted at an angle, there are spaces where things can't be inserted. A spoon holder is not included in the package~ It says in the user manual that the components may be different, but I personally think that you might need a small number of milk bottle trays, so I think it would have been better if there was a spoon holder instead of a milk bottle tray~^^ I put a spoon on top of the small plate tray~ It holds more than I thought~~^^ There was a review about the noise, but I personally didn't find it annoying~ (I guess everyone's perception is different~^^) The downside is that you have to manually add water? I'm thinking about installing it since it has an intake hose~ First, the sink in my house is narrow, so I'm going to study the placement a bit more and ask my uncle~^^ I'll summarize my personal opinions~^^ The design is pretty^^ It's easy to use. The tray moves smoothly. Its components are a drain hose, intake hose, milk bottle tray, water cup, drip tray, and small dish tray. The washing course has five functions: standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam sterilization. You can reserve the start time up to 24 hours. The amount of water used is less than you think (5L). If you do not take out the dishes immediately after washing is complete, the fan will start automatically. You can add dishes during washing. It is the day an illiterate dishwasher person met a new world~~ There is a reason why word of mouth spreads~ It is so nice to be able to go to bed a little earlier~ The washing is clean and the dishes are shiny~ It feels good when I wake up in the morning^^ However, they say that you have to leave the door open when not in use to avoid smells~~^^ Now, thanks to the dishwasher, I can sleep a little more and have a little more freedom in my life~~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): I often have guests at home, so I have a 10-person dishwasher, but it's too big for one meal, so I always washed dishes by hand, but when I saw the 3-person one, I bought it right away! I was worried that it would be too small because it's for 3 people, but I was shocked when I saw the box it was delivered in. It can hold 4 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 4 plates, and a spoon holder~ However, since the spoon holder is in the middle, the dishes go small, so if you have a lot of dishes, you can put the spoon holder on the side or in an empty space. I tried to connect it directly, but the location was ambiguous~ I used the included cup to pour 4 cups! The original standard is over an hour~ With the existing dishwasher, I waited too long, 50 minutes more if you sterilize it in 1 hour~ Since I ate non-oily food, I turned it on fast and it was 29 minutes, which was great! I love fast! It's so nice that the light comes on when you wash it~ I like that it shows you how the washing is progressing! It took a little longer to dry after it was done~ Honestly, I forgot and opened it the next time I was eating, and it was dry! I was a little worried because it was loud, but since I have a kitchen door at home, it's okay if I close it. Now, I can run the dishwasher with peace of mind even after eating a meal. I love that it saves me time to eat and drink coffee! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

The sound isn't loud and it's quiet, so I'm even more satisfied. I used liquid dishwasher detergent because I heard that solid or powdered detergent is inconvenient, and it was easy to control the amount and adjust it, so I liked it. However, when I looked closely at the description sticker attached to the product, there were a few sentences that didn't end. It's a little embarrassing, but it's also something you wouldn't notice if you didn't look closely, and it was so unexpected that I burst out laughing. (This is a different story, but when you use the dishwasher, it's really good for removing water stains if you use conditioner in addition to detergent! I kept getting water stains on my cup, so I looked it up and it said to use conditioner. Since then, there haven't been any water stains and it's great.) Comments (English): If you wash the dishes right after eating, there won't be any piles of dishes, which is good. However, if you do this and that, it becomes annoying and you end up putting it off. In particular, things that need to be soaked in water tend to get forgotten after soaking and are put off until the next day. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, and this time, I was selected for the test group and received a mini dishwasher that was featured in the media. At first, I was surprised that the box was so big, but it was carefully packaged in Styrofoam. And the dishwasher was bigger than I thought. It's a size that fits perfectly in the sink, but it sticks out a little because it gets caught on the side of the dish drying rack at home. When I took out the drain plug on the back of the product, there was some moisture. So I wiped it off with a tissue and turned it on, and there was no problem using it. (According to the manual, it says that it's normal for moisture to remain because it goes through a test before shipment!) You must turn it on before adding water! This is necessary to recognize that water has entered. Do not turn it on or just plug in the cord. If you pour water into the 1.8L measuring cup included three times, the product will make a sound and notify you that the water is full. Even if it is a manual water supply, you only need to pour it three times, so it is not that annoying. (I was worried because there were many stories about the E4 error, but there was no problem when I followed the instructions. -2/7 Added: As I used it, I sometimes pour water without turning on the product with the cord plugged in, but fortunately, it seems to recognize it! When the sound that the water is full came on, the water shape disappeared right away.) There were five methods, but I put in a few dry dishes and a cup for testing and turned it on quickly. Since the dishes were already washed, I used the quick method. The quick method is a good function for washing dishes that do not require separate drying. The standard method takes 1 hour and 4 minutes, but the quick method completes in 29 minutes. When the washing is complete, it beeps to notify you that it is finished. Since it washes at a high temperature, you need to open the door after some time has passed. The quick method without separate drying Because it was spun, there was a lot of moisture inside. When I touched the dishes and cups, they were really clean. They were definitely cleaner than when I washed them by hand. It could be because the dishes didn't have food on them, but when I saw it in operation, it washed so cleanly that I couldn't help but feel that it couldn't be washed cleanly. I'm personally very satisfied. For dishes with a lot of grease or food on them, it's said that they'll be cleaner if you wash them once and then spin them, so I think it would be good to keep that in mind. The sound isn't loud and it's quiet, so I'm even more satisfied. I used liquid dishwasher detergent because I heard that solid or powdered detergent is inconvenient, and it was easy to control the amount and adjust it, so I liked it. However, when I looked closely at the description sticker attached to the product, there were a few sentences that didn't end. It's a little embarrassing, but it's also something you wouldn't notice if you didn't look closely, and it was so unexpected that I burst out laughing. (This is a different story, but when you use the dishwasher, it's really good for removing water stains if you use conditioner in addition to detergent! I kept getting water stains on my cup, so I looked it up and it said to use conditioner. Since then, there haven't been any water stains and it's great.) Sentence (English): We're steadily expanding our newlywed household.
Comments (English): [ Mini Aunt, whose life is prosperous. ] || ---------------- || We're steadily expanding our newlywed household. My husband and I both love cooking, but we absolutely loathe the dishes. Cleaning up after ourselves is always a hassle, so naturally, we wanted to bring in a dishwasher. We live in a Happy House, so we're sensitive to things like perforations. The Media Mini dishwasher is self-installable, so it's perfect! Just connect the drain hose and plug it in, and you're done. It's heavy, so it's up to my husband to decide when to put it on the sink. The orange color is sophisticated and not tacky. I was worried, but it's so fresh and pretty! At first, I skimmed the manual and poured water in with the dishwasher turned off. Fortunately, no errors appeared, but the water level check didn't work. Pressing the reservation and sterilization buttons simultaneously for more than three seconds forces a forced drain. It takes about three minutes, drains the dishwasher, and when I refill it, it recognizes the dishwasher. We had boiled pork for dinner, and the dishes were huge. Things like frying pans are too big to fit, but dishes can fit easily. It's much more spacious than I expected. Washing dishes after eating and cleaning up can easily take up an hour. It's nice to have a dishwasher to do all the dishes, so I can spend the evenings leisurely. I can just run it, wash it, and come out feeling great. If you run it on standard mode, it'll finish washing and then switch to drying mode. It even blows air to dry it! It can run for up to 75 hours, so I can use it without worry when I go out. However, it's a bit noisy, so I wouldn't recommend using it at night. I ran it before bed, and the dryer was so loud that I turned it off and slept with the door open. The next day, it was perfectly dry. The dishes were shiny and shiny. Wow. Dishwasher Auntie, who enriches lives. Affordable price and easy installation. Highly recommended for beginners. ^^ If you found my review helpful, please click [Helpful]. This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher to replace a 10 year old KitchenAid.
Comments (English): [ A strange but very nice dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher to replace a 10 year old KitchenAid. That KitchenAid circuitry was destroyed three times because water got into the circuitry. Wouldn't you expect your dishwasher to be able to keep the electronics dry? So far this one is working well. It is quiet and so far very nice. It is very different than any dishwasher we have ever had. I was a bit reluctant because 1) it does not have a heating element in the dishwasher but instead hooks up to the hot water supply and 2) it automatically pops open at the end of the wash cycle. It pops open to assist with the drying of the dishes. But the dishes are getting clean and they are for the most part dry at the end of the cycle. I would give this five stars for it's performance so far but I reserve one because the true test of quality of a product is how many times you need to pay to have it serviced through the years.

Sentence (English): This is a good basic dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good-Beware Misinformation ] || ---------------- || This is a good basic dishwasher. I preferred the layout and performance of my previous Kitchenaid, but it only lasted 2 years…Lots of misinformation in these reviews:The middle rack is adjustable. The dishwasher comes with the power cord if you don't need it hardwired you don't need to buy anything extra. This model isn't loud, but it's not super quiet either. You can hear it, but can stand next to it and converse without noticing it. It cleans well and buttons are intuitive.It's super easy to install. The easiest we have installed, if you just need to plug into outlet. I like the super duper filters and they are easy to clean. It really does leave quite a bit of condensation in the machine after the wash. I live in a dry climate and didn't use the dry function previously so it's not a big deal, but definitely doesn't dry well on regular setting. Comments (English): [ Very disappointed! LONG wash Cycle. ] || ---------------- || I will start with the only 2 positives. I like the slate color. It matches our other appliances. It does clean my dishes well. Pre-COVID when appliances weren't so expensive, we purchased a GE dishwasher in slate, LOVED IT! But, it died after 4 years. I was hopeful to get another to keep with matching our other appliances, but the same dishwasher we paid roughly $600 is now almost $1,200. I didn't want to invest that much in a dishwasher. I have only used this new dishwasher 3 times, but the wash cycle for a heavy load is 5 hours & 1 minute. Crazy! 5 hours to wash dishes. Then, even with rinse aid totally filled, and the dry boost on high, my dishes still have a considerable amount of water on them. The bottom rack seems wobbly to me. My last complaint is I wish there were true bottons, like the model I bought 4 years ago. This one has a clear film with touch screen options. I didn't like this in the store as on the store models you could see & feel deep scratches from where the dishwasher was rubbing the counter. It seems like ALL brands now have this rather than true buttons. BOSH is the only brand I seem to find that still has buttons, but they don't offer slate. I plan to return this dishwasher after only 3 uses. Thankfully, Best Buy does have a 15 day return policy. Best Buy has been very kind about me wanting to return this item.

Sentence (English): This was purchased to replace the dishwasher that has been in my home for some years.
Comments (English): [ Whirlpool Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This was purchased to replace the dishwasher that has been in my home for some years. I installed the machine myself, which took about 2-3 hours without help and with all the fixtures already in place. With no interruptions or with someone to help you it would easily take much less time. The instructions for installation were mostly clear along with a provided QR code for a video that was some help, though they could be improved on.With about a week of of use now I can say that it does a good job of cleaning my dishes and is INCREDIBLY quiet. The third rack is very small, like you would expect it to be, but also convenient to have for washing additional utensils. I appreciate the various features that came with this model, such as different wash modes, a delayed time start, and a clean indication when a cycle has completed.

Sentence (English): The Media Electric Dishwasher is orange for 3 people!
Comments (English): The Media Electric Dishwasher is orange for 3 people! It arrived just one day after I ordered it! I was surprised to see the box, which was surprisingly large. But when I opened it, I found it safely packaged in thick Styrofoam, both above and below. The dishwasher is small and cute, as befits a 3-person dishwasher! And the orange color really catches my eye when placed in the kitchen! It's so pretty! It's a 3-person dishwasher, but from my perspective, the size seems perfect for a single person or a newlywed. Since we're a family of four, it's a bit tricky to use. So, I only use it for the kids' dishes, water bottles, cups, cutting boards, and spoons that need to be sterilized. I wash the rest by hand. I feel more at ease after pre-washing the dishwasher. After pre-washing, I load the dishes, and then wash the rest. Even for households of 3-4, if installing a dishwasher is difficult or your home is small, it's a good option. I think I'd be okay with buying and using a 3-person dishwasher. The Media Electric Dishwasher 3-person... - It's a no-installation dishwasher, eliminating the hassle of installation, so I was able to install it by myself without my husband's help. It's not too heavy either! It's easier than you think! - Thorough steam sterilization without worrying about bacteria. - Powerful 72-degree high-temperature washing with hot water. - The air circulation system's drying and storage functions. (I leave the door open after washing.) - The powerful water jet and 360-degree rotation create a stream of water that spreads water to every corner, ensuring excellent cleaning performance. (I like being able to visually monitor the dishwasher's cleaning process.) - It has five practical cleaning modes (standard, strong, eco, and rapid steam). You can use the one that best suits your needs. I think the steam function would be great for things like children's dishes, bottles, and baby food. - Since Media will visit you if you need after-sales service, I think I can just request after-sales service if something goes wrong while using it. I'll use it well^^

Comments (English): [ Single-Person Household Review - Convenient, but a little noisy ] || ---------------- || The three new appliances that will change your quality of life are a dishwasher, dryer, and robot vacuum cleaner. As a single-person household, you might not think you'll have much to wash, but sometimes, when you cook kimbap or other dishes, there are more dishes than you'd expect. I chose this product hoping for the convenience of freeing up time for other things. Just as washing machines improved the quality of life when hand washing was common, I was curious if dishwashers would do the same. The pros are: 1. The glass door makes it easy to see what's going on inside. You can stop the machine mid-cycle and adjust the position of dishes. 2. Five practical wash modes. It cleans well. Washing by hand didn't remove the milk smell, but with the wash and sterilization, the tumbler container is clean. - However, pre-washing is essential for severe cases. You need to make sure the dishes are evenly placed. (This can be a bit annoying, and if you put in something like a noodle bowl, the rest won't fit easily, leaving you with limited space.) 3. The 72-hour circulation drying system. It's convenient because you can leave it on while you go out. 4. No installation required, manual water supply. It's a plus because it doesn't require separate installation, but it's also a minus because you have to manually fill 5L of water. This may vary from person to person. Based on my home, it's a plus. The minuses are: 1. It's not very spacious because it's designed to spread the dishes evenly. One noodle bowl can only hold a spoon, a small bowl, and a few cups. It might be a bit cramped for three people. (Of course, if you only put rice and soup bowls in, it might barely fit three people. Adding side dish bowls would be impossible.) However, the outside is larger than the inside, so it might take up a lot of space for one person. I recommend it even if you live alone, as long as you have a large sink. 2. It's a bit noisy. Personally, I think it's louder than a drum washing machine when it's busy. It's probably not ideal for running at night. It's better suited for running it during the day or right before work. 3. It doesn't completely dry. You can hear a fan noise when it's done, but there's still some moisture left. It definitely cleans better (it even removes any residual milk odor from protein shakes!), and it's convenient because you can do other things during that time. However, you still have to do things like frying pans, pots, and cutting boards by hand. And since running the dishwasher takes about 5-6 times longer than just washing dishes, you should probably decide whether to buy one based on your personal lifestyle. I haven't used it for long, so I'm not sure about the electricity bill. I know dishwashers don't use much electricity, but I'm not sure about this one. I run it almost every day, but if my electricity bill goes up, I'll add a review. ------------------------. 6-week review. 1. It doesn't use much electricity. 2. I drink protein shakes, and I wash shake containers and coffee tumblers. It removes odors well. 3. Pots and pans don't fit in the dishwasher, so you have to wash them by hand. Even regular dishes need to be washed beforehand to remove red pepper powder and other contaminants. 4. It's very loud, especially at night. Conclusion! -> The dishes and cups are washed and sterilized, so they're definitely clean. Good odor removal. Highly recommended for washing cups like tumblers. -> The pre-treatment process can be a hassle, and the washing time is long. -> My electricity bill hasn't changed much since last year. (I'm not sure about the air conditioning in the summer, but my spring electricity bill is similar.) This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

The minuses are: 1. It's not very spacious because it's designed to spread the dishes evenly. One noodle bowl can only hold a spoon, a small bowl, and a few cups. It might be a bit cramped for three people. (Of course, if you only put rice and soup bowls in, it might barely fit three people. Adding side dish bowls would be impossible.) However, the outside is larger than the inside, so it might take up a lot of space for one person. I recommend it even if you live alone, as long as you have a large sink. 2. It's a bit noisy. Personally, I think it's louder than a drum washing machine when it's busy. It's probably not ideal for running at night. It's better suited for running it during the day or right before work. 3. It definitely cleans better (it even removes any residual milk odor from protein shakes!), and it's convenient because you can do other things during that time. However, you still have to do things like frying pans, pots, and cutting boards by hand. And since running the dishwasher takes about 5-6 times longer than just washing dishes, you should probably decide whether to buy one based on your personal lifestyle. Conclusion! -> The dishes and cups are washed and sterilized, so they're definitely clean. Good odor removal. Highly recommended for washing cups like tumblers. -> The pre-treatment process can be a hassle, and the washing time is long. -> My electricity bill hasn't changed much since last year. (I'm not sure about the air conditioning in the summer, but my spring electricity bill is similar.) I chose this product hoping for the convenience of freeing up time for other things. Just as washing machines improved the quality of life when hand washing was common, I was curious if dishwashers would do the same. The pros are: 1.
